questions.stem: Which process does a dialysis machine use to remove waste products from the blood?

options.text: Active transport across a partially permeable membrane
Osmosis across a fully permeable membrane
Diffusion across a partially permeable membrane

questions.explanation: In dialysis, waste products like urea diffuse from the blood (where they are at high concentration) across a partially permeable membrane into the dialysis fluid (where they are at low concentration).
